title: Mother and Baby on Lawn Cushion, Garden Porch - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet domestic outdoor snapshot taken on August 19, 1932, depicting a smiling young woman seated on the grassy lawn holding a young baby who is propped up on a patterned cushion. The woman wears a classic early 1930s short-sleeved patterned dress with a wide white collar and dark low-heeled shoes, while the baby is dressed in a light summer romper. Behind them are leafy garden shrubs and a classic American wooden clapboard house with a front porch, offering an intimate glimpse of family life during the Great Depression era.
